intro: Thunder Axe Fortress is a fortified compound in northwestern Desolace serving as a stronghold for the demonic Burning Blade cult. Within its stone barracks, watchtowers, and darkened caves, cultists perform dark rituals to summon demonic entities and store stolen artifacts of power. The cult remains an active threat to anyone traversing the desolate wastes.

sections.t: A Bastion of the Burning Blade
p: Perched in northwestern Desolace, Thunder Axe Fortress serves as a heavily guarded redoubt for the Burning Blade. Composed of stone barracks, defensive watchtowers, and deep caverns, it allows the cult to maintain a fortified foothold far from the gaze of Kalimdor's major cities. Here, the cultists gather fel energies, summon lesser demons, and concoct schemes to bring far more dangerous entities into the world.
